This wiki runs on MediaWiki, hosted by Miraheze. Once it is live, editing happens on the wiki itself.

<span id="edit-a-page"></span>
== Edit a page ==

# Log in, open the page and choose '''Edit''' (or '''Edit source''').
# Make your change, add a short summary of what you changed, and save.
# Check the result and fix it if the layout broke.

<span id="wikitext-basics"></span>
== Wikitext basics ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! You want
! Type
|-
| A link to another page
| <code><nowiki>[[Page title]]</nowiki></code> or <code><nowiki>[[Page title|link text]]</nowiki></code>
|-
| A link to another site
| <code>[https://example.com link text]</code>
|-
| A heading
| <code>== Heading ==</code> (use <code>===</code> for a subheading)
|-
| A bullet
| <code>* item</code>
|-
| A numbered item
| <code># item</code>
|-
| Bold, italic
| <code>'''bold'''</code>, <code>''italic''</code>
|-
| Put a page in a category
| <code><nowiki>[[Category:About]]</nowiki></code> at the bottom
|-
| An image
| <code><nowiki>[[File:Name.png|thumb|Caption]]</nowiki></code>
|}

<span id="creating-a-page"></span>
== Creating a page ==

Search for the title. If it does not exist, follow the “create this page” link, then link to it from a landing page so people can find it. See [[Where things go]].

<span id="naming"></span>
== Naming ==

* Page titles use sentence case (“How to edit”, not “How To Edit”).
* Pages in the Company Brain set are prefixed “Company Brain/”.
